Hi Alice / MedSys team — attaching the deliverables we discussed. Overview below and where each artifact maps to your auditor checklist: 

Attachments included: redwood_network_segmentation_v1.pdf (internal, labeled), redwood_network_segmentation_v1_redacted.png (auditor-ready), soc2_evidence_index.csv (artifact index), walkthrough-recording-20260212.mp4 (recording).

Short narrative (summary):
- Logical segmentation: Hosted (Redwood API) uses tenant-aware routing in a shared control plane; Dedicated instances are provisioned into customer-specific GPU pools and peered VPCs. Private deployments can run in customer VPCs with a customer-managed transit; we provide a management/control plane that is logically separated and communicates via mTLS over dedicated peering.
- Egress controls: Egress is mediated through NAT gateways and egress ACLs; we support per-tenant egress allowlists and egress logging (flow logs forwarded to customer/logging buckets).
- Control plane separation: In Private deployments the control plane runs in a customer-isolated VPC with restricted management interfaces; data plane traffic (model inference) is pinned to tenant compute and does not traverse the control plane except for metadata and telemetry (encrypted in transit).

Redaction note: The attached PNG is sanitized; the full PDF contains internal comments and can be provided under a signed evidence request. For quick reference I also added a mapping from diagram nodes to SOC 2 control families in the CSV.
